verdict.rationale: There is genuine open-format export evidence (audit dump of device info + relying parties to JSON/CSV, and TOTP seed export to CSV/JSON), which supports local data portability, but Token2 is a hardware security-key vendor rather than a data-hosting platform, so the 'export everything and leave' story is thin and narrowly scoped to device/credential metadata. missing for 10: comprehensive account/data export beyond device credentials, explicit data-portability policy, independent confirmation the export is complete/lossless.
